thread:
Priya: Quick thread for a precision-cohort rollout for eu model-v2. Goal: limit blast radius and get high-signal telemetry early. Plan sketch below.
Omar: Outline please. Want deterministic cohorts, telemetry gates, and a minimal shadow window.
Priya: Phase 0: header-driven slices for QA (X-RW-Slice: slice-<id>). Phase 1: 8 tenant cohorts (deterministic list) ~12% traffic. Phase 2: broaden to 35% with added random pct. Shadow 4% baseline async for 18h.
Jin: Deterministic slice = 👌. Also: include an enterprise allowlist so paying customers never get auto-swapped. We'll surface allowlist in Console.
Claire: Gate thresholds proposal: automated rollback if rolling_error_rate >0.75% for 4m OR p95 latency >350ms above baseline for 10m OR token_cost delta >40% for 15m. Otherwise promote.
Mateo: Add a quality gate: sample 200 completions from each cohort, run a small automated eval (BLEU/embedding drift + rerank delta). Fail if avg rerank shift >0.12 or mean embedding drift >0.09.
Priya: Telemetry payload: variant, tenant_id, slice_id, trace_id, token_count. Key metrics: error_rate, p50/p95, token_cost, embedding_cosine_mean, rerank_shift. Emit compact health ping every 60s.
Omar: Ops: implement /health?variant=v2 returning {version, kv_cache_hit, last_1m_p95}. k8s readiness can use it. Also add a warmup limiter: cap instance qps for first 10m after promotion.
Jin: Circuit-breaker semantics: on automated rollback, open circuit for that slice for 45m and block auto-promote for 3h. Region-wide rollback opens 1h block and requires a manual re-eval. Log to rollout-audit and notify #incidents.
Claire: Shadowing: async mirror header X-RW-Shadow: true. Shadow responses go to a separate index for offline diffing. Cost note: infra estimates +7-9% GPU hours for 18h at current qps.
Mateo: For cohort selection, pick a mix: low-risk high-traffic tenants + feature users (embeddings + chat) to catch both latency and quality regressions. Use deterministic hashing to keep slices stable.
Priya: Flag schema: eu_model_v2 -> {mode: header|cohort|pct, value, allowlist, shadow_pct, warmup_secs}. Console needs per-tenant variant view and quarantine state.
Omar: Add a quarantine path: if a cohort trips quality gate, automatically route that cohort to compat-model-v1 and mark "quarantined" with reason. Quarantine TTL default 2h then re-validate with synthetic job.
Jin: Audit trail: every automated decision (promote, rollback, quarantine) should emit a compact event with reason, metric snapshot, and actor=system into rollout-audit. Useful for postmortem.
Claire: Also hook an eval-sampling job: 200 prompts per cohort ran every 3h during rollout window. If any cohort fails, mark for manual review.
DeployBot: job-90021 started: applying header routing and flag eu_model_v2 mode=cohort value=12%. step-1 OK.
Mateo: UX ask: expose a debug header X-RW-Force-Slice so support can reproduce exact routing outside cohort. Also add read-only list of current cohort members to Console.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to draft RFC with exact cohort lists, thresholds, and sample evals (due tomorrow 11am). 2) Omar to add variant health endpoint + warmup limiter. 3) Jin to implement quarantine automation + audit events. 4) Claire to wire eval-sampling and telemetry pings. 5) Mateo to update flag schema and Console slices.
Omar: Let's schedule a 25m shiproom after RFC to sanity-check.
Jin: +1. I'll prepare rollback playbook snippet.
Mateo: I'll run a quick cost calc and post in RFC.
Priya: If no objections by 4pm I'll post RFC and tag SRE/legal. :thumbsup:
Claire: ACK
DeployBot: job-90021 apply-step-1 complete at 1729802585.
